about.description: edgeX is a high-performance perpetual contract DEX incubated by Amber Group, with its MVP launched in July 2024 on StarkEx. The order-book engine targets CEX-grade execution with up to 200K TPS and ZK-proven settlement; users self-custody assets while accessing up to 100x leverage on BTC pairs across multichain support spanning 70+ chains. Markets cover equities, equity indices, commodities, and crypto, with positions margined and cash-settled in USDC. edgeX is migrating to its own dedicated EDGE Chain L2 in conjunction with its March 31, 2026 EDGE Token Generation Event (1B EDGE total supply, 25% allocated to airdrops).
about.registryInfo: edgeX is a high-performance perpetual DEX incubated by Amber Group (a leading global digital-asset trading firm). The MVP (edgeX V1) launched in July 2024 on StarkEx; the protocol is transitioning to its own dedicated EDGE Chain L2 and conducted its EDGE Token Generation Event on March 31, 2026, with 25% of the 1B EDGE supply allocated to airdrops.

fees.revenueNotes: edgeX base fees (non-VIP): 1.2 bps maker / 3.8 bps taker. VIP tiers based on 30-day rolling volume reduce fees down to 0 bps maker / 2.4 bps taker at VIP 6 ($2B+ volume). Hourly funding fees apply between longs and shorts. Same schedule applies to crypto and RWA markets. Source: https://edgex-1.gitbook.io/edgeX-documentation/trading/trading-fees
